meta.name: France and the Low Countries
meta.note: Approximate reconstruction. The final keyframe is the armistice demarcation line, so the unoccupied south-east stays Allied-coloured to the end: France is beaten in six weeks but the Vichy zone is never entered.

keyframes.label: Fall Gelb. Germany invades the Netherlands, Belgium and Luxembourg.
Rotterdam is bombed. The Panzers cross the Meuse at Sedan.
The Panzers reach the sea at Abbeville. The Allied armies are cut in two.
Belgium surrenders. The pocket closes on Dunkirk.
Fall Rot. The offensive turns south against the Somme and the Aisne.
Paris is occupied without a fight. The government has gone to Bordeaux.
The armistice is signed at Compiegne, in the same railway carriage as in 1918.
